entries.result: Rent roll shows 2 of 48 units offline for renovation. With 46 of 48 units in service, occupancy by unit count is at most 95.83%. Whether each of the 46 is leased and occupied was not given.
entries.needs: Lease status of each of the 46 units and the rent roll's as-of date. Lets the parties see occupancy on the date they are relying on.

stated.value: One-bedrooms at $1,450 and two-bedrooms at $1,850 (24 x $1,450 + 24 x $1,850 = $79,200.00 per month; $950,400.00 per year)
stated.source: Offering memorandum (date and page not supplied)

evidence.source: Seller's rent roll (undated), figures as read by the user

entries.result: Rent roll: 20 x $1,410 + 26 x $1,790 = $74,740.00 per month ($896,880.00 per year), on 46 units. That is $4,460.00 per month ($53,520.00 per year) below the OM, or 94.37% of the OM figure. Averages are $40.00 (one-bedroom) and $60.00 (two-bedroom) below the OM rents.
entries.needs: Whether the OM rents are in-place or pro forma, and whether the rent roll averages are contract rent or collected rent. Lets the parties see which rent figure is actual.

entries.result: No leases or lease abstracts supplied. The rent roll figures have not been reconciled to leases.
entries.needs: Leases or abstracts for the 46 units (start, expiry, rent, concessions). Lets the parties see whether the rent roll rents are the contract rents and how long they run.

entries.result: No expense figures, operating statement or T-12 supplied.
entries.needs: T-12 operating statement, with tax and insurance bills. Lets the parties see what it costs to operate the property.

entries.result: No NOI was stated and none can be computed: other income, vacancy and collections, and expenses are not on record.
entries.needs: The OM's NOI figure and the T-12 it rests on. Lets the parties see actual NOI, the input a value decision rests on.

stated.source: Seller's rent roll (undated), as read by the user

entries.result: Seller's rent roll statement only. Scope, cost, completion date and who pays are not stated. The OM does not mention the offline units.
entries.needs: Renovation scope, budget, spend to date, expected return-to-service date and who bears the remaining cost, from the seller. Lets the parties see when the 2 units can earn rent and at what cost.

entries.result: No asking price or offer was stated. Pencil does not determine value; that decision belongs to the parties.
entries.needs: The asking or offered price, from the OM or the listing broker. With a verified NOI, Pencil can compute the cap rate at that price; the parties decide what the property is worth to them.
